paper_metadata.title: Preparation and Performance Analysis of Nb Matrix Composites Reinforced by Reactants of Nb and SiC

evidence.section: Abstract
evidence.quote: In this paper, one kind of new composite material formed with Nb and SiC was prepared by hot pressing sintering.

evidence.section: Introduction
evidence.quote: The laminated Nb/Nb5Si3 composites had been synthesized in situ by Yu et al. [4]. Nb5Si3 phase was the reinforcement and Nbss had great plasticity, which could enhance the fracture toughness.

evidence.section: 2. Experimental Procedure
evidence.quote: The Nb-xSiC powders (x = 3%, 5%, 7% molar ratio) were ball milled in a QM-BP planetary ball mill under Ar protective environment. The powders, weighing 30 g, were put together with steel balls. The ball-to-powder ratio was 15:1. In order to prevent the powder from welding during the ball milling, 20 mL ethanol was added to the pot. The ball milling time was 25 h and the speed was 250 r/min.

evidence.section: 4. Conclusions
evidence.quote: The relative density of material sintered was 97%, indicating that the material had good compactness.

evidence.section: 3.2.2. Mechanical Properties of Nb Matrix Composites at Room Temperature
evidence.quote: Nb2C and Nb3Si, which are both hard and brittle phases, embed into Nbss, hindering the movement of dislocation during deformation and having the function of dispersion hardening.

evidence.section: 3.2.2. Mechanical Properties of Nb Matrix Composites at Room Temperature
evidence.quote: with the increasing of SiC content, the grain boundary surface area increases. It hinders the movement of dislocations during deformation.

evidence.section: 3.2.2. Mechanical Properties of Nb Matrix Composites at Room Temperature

evidence.section: 3.2.2. Mechanical Properties of Nb Matrix Composites at Room Temperature
evidence.quote: cracks existed only in the Nb 2C and Nb3Si grains and ended at the grain boundary of Nbss, also known as crack arrest (CA).
